2187-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2187-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1021-4826-5413-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving Trenching Steed +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

141-5100-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5100-5231.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {R}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4549-6112--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2060-2464-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least four counters on it.
Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2060-2464-4687.description:
Activate Song of Freyalise by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2459-3927-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Sakashima's Protege.
Repeat.

2728-5256-5662-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-5256-5662-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-5256-5662-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2757-4573-4772.description:
Activate Sacred Mesa by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Doubling Season.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3504-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3504-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3504-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

864-1987-2020.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
864-1987-2020.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-2020.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

240-5231-5470-7730.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1628-2981-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1628-2981-3490-7426.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Berta triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat

891-1258-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Abduction triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

277-280-774.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Golgari Rot Farm's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
277-280-774.notes: After gaining an arbitrarily large amount of mana, you may repeat the loop choosing Tiller Engine's other mode to tap any number of nonland permanents opponents control.

6798-7124-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
6798-7124-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
6798-7124-7358.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

1766-1978-7329.description:
Animate Thran Dynamo using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3129-3899-4552-7290.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Does Machines.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-4905-5220-7192.description:
Cast Fanatical Firebrand by paying its mana cost.
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

628-5231-7191.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

851-4017-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-4017-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

955-2366-2800-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
955-2366-2800-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5485-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5485-7060.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-1329-1482-3480.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1497-2092-4949-5217.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W} that can only be spent to activate an ability of a creature.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

4222-5115-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had three nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
4222-5115-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least three charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array three times by removing three charge counters from it, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

413-2178-3362-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
413-2178-3362-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

510-2281-2921.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4377-4823-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Timeless Witness each turn.
4377-4823-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Timeless Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Timeless Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1479-3861-4288.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3861-4288.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Sarinth Greatwurm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1571-2154-4452-5728.notablePrerequisites: Aspiring Champion does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1571-2154-4452-5728.description:
Cast Sylvan Tutor by paying {G}, searching your library for Blightsteel Colossus and putting it on top of your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aspiring Champion.
Aspiring Champion triggers, causing you to sacrifice it, then reveal Blightsteel Colossus from the top of your library and put it onto the battlefield as a Demon due to Rukarumel, Biologist, then causing Blightsteel Colossus to give each opponent eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1753-3259-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

222-2438-4871-5221.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Sporuting Thrinax and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Sprouting Thrinax die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Sprouting Thrinax triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2474-3011-3333.easyPrerequisites:
Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Each opponent has a life total of 2 or greater.
2474-3011-3333.description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal damage to each player equal to 3/2 their life total, with your life total being unchanged due to Platinum Emperion.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

331-2560-3059.description:
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to twice its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1939-3179-3613-4050.description:
Cast Lunarch Veteran from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {W}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Lunarch Phantom.
Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lunarch Phantom, adding {W}.
Because Dress Down causes Lunarch Phantom to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Lunarch Veteran.
Repeat.

575-622-2167.description:
Activate a Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kamahl by paying {1}{G}, causing the Forest to become a 1/1 Elemental that is still a land until end of turn.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing the Forest, adding {G}.
The Forest dies, triggering Yedora, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Repeat.

1414-2854-4311-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1414-2854-4311-4574.description:
Cast Lotus Petal either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

614-1987-3075-4714.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
614-1987-3075-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.
